purpose: Bounded operator-support worker for GitHub repo triage and deeper-review recommendation.

notes: no real problem solved for us

stop_conditions: repo cannot be classified with available evidence
repo appears unsafe to inspect further
repo requires code execution to verify core claims
repo scope exceeds bounded intake review
escalation_conditions: repo appears materially useful but classification confidence is low
conflicting evidence between README/docs and code
fatal flag triggered but repo still appears strategically interesting
